description: Screen the global Bullrun stock universe with the app rule engine using custom fundamental rules or named presets: profitable value, dividend income, growth and cash flow, cash generators, dividend growth. action=list_presets discloses exact thresholds, units, annual lookback and sorting without any backend request. action=run (default) executes one preset or custom rules; running uses the API's metered screening budget. Custom screens support sector/industry/country, listing controls, annual/quarterly lookback, AND/OR rule groups and money units. Presets are mechanical starting points, not recommendations or famous-investor strategies. Read-only.

action.description: list_presets discloses named screens without any backend request; run executes a preset or custom rules and uses the metered screening budget.

countries.description: Exact country names to include. Use this for multi-country screens; it overrides country when provided.

country.description: Exact country name to filter by, e.g. "United States", "Germany". Omit for all countries.

includeInactive.description: Include delisted/inactive tickers with no recent price bar. Default false.

includeSecondary.description: Include secondary cross-listings of the same security. Default false (primary listings only).

industry.description: Exact industry name to filter by, e.g. "Software - Infrastructure". Omit for all industries.

limit.description: Maximum stocks to return: custom default 25 (1-100), preset default 20 (1-50).

lookback.description: How many reporting periods to evaluate (default 3). Growth rules need at least 2 comparable periods; presets require 2-10 annual observations.

lookbackMode.description: Whether rule evaluation uses annual or quarterly reporting periods. Default annual; presets require annual.

minMarketCap.description: Compatibility shortcut: adds marketCap >= this absolute value to every rule group.

mode.description: Deprecated alias for lookbackMode; kept for compatibility.

order.description: Sort direction. Custom default desc; presets use their disclosed order. Nulls always sort last regardless of direction.

periods.description: Deprecated alias for lookback; kept for compatibility.

preset.description: Optional named screen. Presets use disclosed fixed rules/sorting, annual lookback (2-10 years), primary active listings and a default limit of 20 (maximum 50). Omit for custom rules; do not combine with rules or minMarketCap.

rules.description: Fundamental rules. Same groupId means AND; different groupIds mean OR.

groupId.description: Rules with the same groupId are ANDed; different groups are ORed.

operator.description: Comparison operator. Use '..' for an inclusive between range.

unit.description: Optional money unit for money metrics: '', K, M, B or T.

value.description: Threshold value. For money metrics, combine with unit for K/M/B/T scaling.

valueMax.description: Upper bound for '..' range rules. Ignored for other operators.

sector.description: Exact sector name to filter by, e.g. "Technology", "Healthcare". Omit for all sectors.

sortBy.description: Metric to sort by. Custom default marketCap; presets use their disclosed sorting. revenueGrowth is accepted as an alias for revenueGrowthPct.

name: screen_stocks
title: Screen stocks
